ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: The surface is dominated by low-intensity (black) pixels (approx. 70%) with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters concentrated on the distal lateral sections of both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white patches are mapped to the outer thirds of both lobes. A distinct dark circular pixel ring is embedded within the white field of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A narrow V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex angle approximately 15 degrees, bisecting the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge characterized by high-frequency, sharp-peaked serrations with varying pixel-amplitudes across the entire linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a concave curve that sweeps upward and outward toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular, high-contrast, raised pixel structures are visible at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, vertical low-intensity lines are visible crossing the high-intensity white patch on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A unique, dark circular ring-shaped mark ('donut' pattern) is located in the upper quadrant of the right lobe's white patch.
other_distinctive_markers: Extreme jaggedness and pixel protrusions on the terminal tips of the lobes compared to the relatively smoother serrations near the median notch.
